_meta.purpose: Canonical map of all prompt-like files (system prompts, agent instructions, identity manifests). No files were moved or deleted.

existing_prompts.role: Agent workspace rules and engineering mandate
Machine-readable identity with personality traits, design patterns, and metacognition config
Runtime prompt preprocessing with deterministic and LLM-enhanced paths
Compiles prompts into structured missions with safety gates

proposed_canonical_prompts.objective: Unified agent identity, personality, engineering mandate, and collaboration rules. Replaces AGENTS.md + GEMINI.md + IDENTITY.md + SOUL.md + MAD_COORDINATION_PROTOCOL.md for agent consumption.
proposed_canonical_prompts.when_used: Prepended to every agent session as system context.

proposed_canonical_prompts.objective: Classify task difficulty and determine model tier routing. Supplements the regex-based classify_task_complexity() in model_router.py.
proposed_canonical_prompts.when_used: Before every task routing decision when LLM classification is enabled.

proposed_canonical_prompts.objective: Clean and normalize raw user prompts. Extract intents, detect language, identify layer references.
proposed_canonical_prompts.when_used: First step of the preprocessing pipeline.
proposed_canonical_prompts.output_schema: {refined_prompt: str, intent: str, layers: list[str], suborders: list[str]}

proposed_canonical_prompts.objective: Compress RAG results, graph query outputs, and memory recalls into dense bullet-points for cloud consumption.
proposed_canonical_prompts.when_used: After graph/memory retrieval, before cloud escalation.

proposed_canonical_prompts.objective: Design structural changes, create implementation plans, decide multi-layer refactoring strategy.
proposed_canonical_prompts.when_used: When complexity == CRITICAL and task involves architecture/design.

proposed_canonical_prompts.objective: Generate precise code diffs and mutations for complex multi-file changes.
proposed_canonical_prompts.when_used: When complexity >= COMPLEX and task involves code generation/refactoring.

proposed_canonical_prompts.objective: Decompose a mission into a DAG of subtasks assigned to specialized agents.
Generate exact tool invocation arguments for MCP tools given their schemas.
proposed_canonical_prompts.when_used: When a skill/tool needs to be called and arguments must be constructed.

proposed_canonical_prompts.objective: Audit diffs, payloads, and permissions for injection, path traversal, or policy violations.
proposed_canonical_prompts.when_used: Before any code mutation is applied. During quarantine pipeline.

proposed_canonical_prompts.objective: Translate natural language questions into Cypher queries for the Kùzu graph database.
proposed_canonical_prompts.when_used: When the brain needs to query the semantic/relational graph.

proposed_canonical_prompts.objective: Operational workspace rules: execution protocol, blocked paths, diff policy, handoff requirements, documentation contracts.
proposed_canonical_prompts.when_used: Loaded once per session alongside sys_identity.

proposed_canonical_prompts.objective: Verification policy: how agents validate claims before acting. Sources of truth, evidence rules, prohibited assumptions.
proposed_canonical_prompts.when_used: Loaded once per session as governance context.

proposed_canonical_prompts.objective: Unified auditor for agent/skill/MCP creation and download. Parametric by entity_type with shared base checks and type-specific branches.
proposed_canonical_prompts.when_used: During quarantine pipeline when new entities are created or downloaded.
proposed_canonical_prompts.input_schema: {entity_type: str, manifest: dict, source_code: str, origin: str}
proposed_canonical_prompts.output_schema: {approved: bool, entity_type: str, violations: list, risk_score: float, recommendation: str, required_permissions: list}

proposed_canonical_prompts.objective: Generate Cypher write operations for Kùzu. Complements graph_query_generator (reads) with create/update/batch mutations.
proposed_canonical_prompts.when_used: When the brain needs to write to the semantic/relational graph.

summary.total_legacy_tokens_wasted_per_session: ~3760 tokens loaded from 5 redundant identity/prompt files
critical_issues: 5 root files (AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, IDENTITY.md, SOUL.md, MAD_COORDINATION_PROTOCOL.md) all contribute to agent system context with overlapping and sometimes contradictory rules
The _PREPROCESS_SYSTEM_PROMPT in prompt_preprocessor.py is hardcoded — should be externalized to local_sanitizer.md
.aiwg/identity.json defines personality traits that conflict with SOUL.md narrative
